description: Token cost estimate per significant file. Use this to decide whether a file is worth loading.
methodology: 1 token ≈ 4 characters. Estimates rounded to nearest 500.

NEVER_LOAD.reason: Streamlit UI orchestration — only load for UI changes.
DL selector implementations — only load when modifying LSTM/Transformer/GNN/XGBoost logic.
Full experiment log — use experiments.json graph instead.
Raw JSON outputs — ask for targeted metric extracts, never load in full.
Real-time prediction engine — only load for live prediction work.
Headline WFV script — only load when modifying the WFV logic itself.
Large ablation script — only load when modifying ablation logic.

SAFE_TO_LOAD.loadWhen: Modifying a selector, signal model, or core module.
Running or building an experiment; reviewing results.
Environment setup, cluster jobs, dependency changes.
Any change that feels tricky or involves known gotchas.
Quick architecture reference (alternative to full KG load).
Modifying backtesting logic, IndianCosts, or BacktestConfig.
Modifying Stage 2 signal models (ZScore, OU, Kalman, MLSignal).
Modifying report saving or benchmark comparison logic.
Modifying data fetching, DataConfig, or frequency settings.
Modifying Correlation, Distance, Cointegration, or CombinedCriteria selectors.
Checking or changing universe, DEFAULT_MIN_HOLD, or RANDOM_SEED.
Full thesis roadmap needed (prefer experiments.json graph for quick lookups).
Cluster execution guidance — SLURM job submission workflow.
Need exact run commands (prefer build-and-config.json for quick lookups).
Modifying ensemble weighting or combination logic.
